name: AAWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The AAWA's own top prize, first seen around Rip Daddy Scorpio's waist on the premiere edition of Saturday Night Fight -- a title the fed itself, not a rival's commentary, put into the record.
notes: First attested holder and only reign recorded from this pass's own read; the corpus's own earlier and later dated posts (not read in full) may carry further title history.

name: AAWA Master of Mayhem Championship
epitaph: A hardcore-flavored second belt already around Miguel Sanchez's waist by this pass's own first sighting of him -- won, per the show's own recap, in a steel cage match against Death Demon and 'Rowdy' Ryan that survives only as backstory, not as a document in this pass's own held corpus.
notes: Do not invent a title match where none was billed.
